title: Dynamic Fly BETA
features:
Explanation

Dynamic Fly Is A Fly Script With A Modern UI, VehicleSeat Support, Adjustable Speed, Light/Dark Mode And Some Other Stuff.

~

You Can Change The Fly Value, Speed Value And UIScale Externally If You Want To Adjust Them Or Use Them With Your Own Keybinds / GUI.

~

The GUI Can Be Dragged Around, Minimized And Expanded, And It Also Has A Topbar Button When Minimized.

~

PC Controls

F ~ Fly / Unfly
W / A / S / D ~ Move
Q ~ Down
E ~ Up
LeftControl + F ~ Minimize / Expand

~

Extra Description

Default Toggle: false
Default Theme: Light
Default Speed: 32 SPS
Version: V0.9.8 (Beta)

~

Coded By aabaaii13

~
